basis: Explicit user request on 2026-08-02 to speed up the E2 matrix and run grid cells in parallel instead of the 10-hour two-lane schedule.
unchanged_items: model identity and thinking mode (packy-deepseek-v4-flash thinking-high)
temperature (0.0), metrics, estimands, exclusion rules, sample size (60 cells)
all science code file hashes (unchanged from the original v8 freeze)

transport_changes.detail: Six independent lane supervisor processes, one per seed pair; each run keeps per-request concurrency 6; total in-flight requests 36.
transport_changes.rationale: Seed batches are independent; the only serialization inside a seed is the frozen five-condition loop. Parallel seeds reduce wall clock from ~10h to ~3.5h.
transport_changes.risk_control: Total in-flight 36 exceeds the r3 failure load (28) but the current transport has 600s timeouts, SDK-level retries, no overlapping paid jobs, and has been failure-free for 2+ hours at 12 in-flight. First-batch health is watched; any lane exception still stops all new paid batches.

transport_changes.detail: OpenAI SDK exponential-backoff retry for all 5xx (including Cloudflare 520) and connection errors; gateway max_attempts stays 3; fatal errors still abort immediately.
transport_changes.rationale: Covers tens-of-seconds provider outages (the observed 520 requested a >=60s backoff).

transport_changes.detail: r7 cells already written with complete terminal artifacts are reused by the lane runner's existing reuse path (reused_terminal_artifacts counters); no cell is re-paid or overwritten. In-flight cells are allowed to finish before the switch so no partial artifacts are created.

lane_seed_assignment.note: Seeds 1103/1201 and cell 1409/full already have or will have complete r7 terminal artifacts and are reused without re-payment.

switch_procedure.step_1: Wait for lane A to finish the seed1103 batch (5/5 VALID terminal batch summary).
switch_procedure.step_2: Wait for lane B to finish the seed1409/full cell (VALID terminal summary) and stop lane B before it starts seed1409/full_minus_memory.
switch_procedure.step_4: Start six lane supervisors with the lane_seed_assignment above, same frozen r7 config and lane runner.

stop_rule_unchanged: Each lane stops on its first exception or non-five-for-five-VALID batch. Any failure stops all new paid jobs pending an explicit audited recovery amendment.
claim_boundary: This amendment changes execution scheduling and retry transport only. It does not change any scientific parameter or the identity of the r7 attempt; all cells remain within carr_s_e2_v8_formal_r7.
